items.title: Tim Kelly Interview, 1978-12-03
items.q: I had met him in Shreveport and we became fast friends. But he was with Doc Ross' band out in Los Angeles. So, he wired for me to come. I drove 2,000 miles out to play with Jack. Two Doc Ross' jazz bandits.

ctx.x: Gullick. And, Thomas Joyner. Now, these are names you may not be familiar with, but they're well-known, well-well-known at this time. But, Jack was the outstanding star. Is that the same as Tommy Joyner?
